Asset type: original production 2D side-scroller scenery sprite atlas, transparent PNG.
Primary request: Four separate painted objects in an evenly spaced 2 by 2 grid on a 1536 by 1024 canvas. Top left: low broad weathered blue-gray stone village fountain with a little carved star finial, copper spout and quiet turquoise water in its basin, solid plinth on flat ground. Top right: roofed wooden community notice board on two stout legs, five small weathered pinned papers without readable writing. Bottom left: arched wrought-iron garden trellis with climbing dark ivy and sparse pale violet flowers, two clearly visible stone feet. Bottom right: a brass celestial armillary with interlocking spherical rings on a short carved stone pedestal, base on flat ground.

Layout: each complete object contained within its own 768 by 512 cell, at least 35px transparent margin all around each cell. Similar visual weight. No overlaps, no scenery, no floor strip, no people, no lettering or labels or grid lines, no watermark. Actual transparent alpha background and clear silhouette edges.
